realm: The Black Iron Court of Dominion
coreTone: infernal contracts, black iron courts, ash thrones, chain law, and ambition powerful enough to terrify oblivion
thesis: Infernal Titans believe survival belongs to those strong enough to command ruin rather than flee it.
centralConflict: They can weaponize catastrophe better than any Realm, but every alliance with them asks who will hold the chain afterward.
realmHazards: chains that punish weakness and mercy alike
campaignHooks: Negotiate with a Cinder Broker
break a Hollow army using forbidden chain-law
decide whether Dominion ambition is a weapon or the next Collapse
visualLanguage: black iron, ember red, volcanic courts, chain halos, horned silhouettes, ash banners, molten sigils
